items: ½ cup maple syrup or honey

steps: Add nut butter and maple syrup or honey into a bowl and microwave for 30 seconds.
In a large mixing bowl, combine protein powder, rolled oats and chocolate chips.
Pour nut butter and syrup mix over dry ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Press firmly into a baking paper lined baking tray and refridgerate for 1-2 hours until firm.
Cut into 16 slices and enjoy chilled.

notes: You can skip the chocolate chips, or replace with dried fruit. If the mixture is too dry, add a little oat milk or more syrup.

recipe_info.title: Protein oat slice
recipe_info.intro: A tasty and (relatively) healthy protein powder oat slice. Delicious as a dessert served with yoghurt!
